about: The rows tool:check-copy judges when the caller sends no rules of its own: only mechanical grammar, which names no word, no product and no person. A caller with its own rules (word lists, phrases, patterns) sends them as `rules`; they are never kept here. These rows judge typing, so they skip kinds read from pictures.

rules.says: A sentence starts with a capital letter.
A new sentence starts with a capital letter.
A sentence ends with a full stop, a question mark or an exclamation mark.
The same word twice in a row.
A bracket or quote is opened and never closed.
No space before a comma or a full stop.
